title: A Silence for the Interior
author: Gideon Brightwater
blurb: Theo Oyelaran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
